title: A rep who no longer exists or is in another organization reads Unassigned
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; "Sales Representative - Labor" reads {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" holds {Staff-member-C}, whose staff record no longer exists.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001 and {Staff-member-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Gone Rep.
  • Work order {Work-order-2} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; its one "Sales Representative" field holds {Staff-member-D}, a staff member of another organization.
    For example: {Work-order-2} is S2-40002 and {Staff-member-D} is ZZAUTOTEST Other Org Rep.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at {Work-order-1}'s Sales Representative fields without clicking them.
  2. Open {Work-order-2} and look at its Sales Representative field.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Sales Representative - Parts" reads "Unassigned", never a bare "(Inactive)"; "Sales Representative - Labor" still reads {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 2: the Sales Representative field reads "Unassigned", never a bare "(Inactive)".

A manual tester cannot set up this case: a staff record stops existing, or sits in another organization, only through a data repair. The developers check it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-E3: “A side whose staff member no longer exists, or belongs to another organization, reads "Unassigned" on the card, as on the printout (S6-N1). It never reads a bare "(Inactive)".”
  • Story 6 context note (S6-N1, S1-E3, S7-R6): “* Context note (S6-N1, S1-E3, S7-R6): a staff record stops existing only through a data repair; ShopView offers no way to delete one. Developers check these cases; manual QA cannot set them up.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 5: “5. Card: (a) "Unassigned". Audit Log: (d) "Unassigned". Same as the printout.”
  • Chris Ward's answer 30: “30. (b) Only through a data repair, so the developers check it, not a manual tester.”
